steps.do: Click “Login” in the header, then “Continue with a wallet”, choose MetaMask and approve the sign-in message in the wallet.

notes.text: This is the production site. The user is logged in with a wallet; type no email anywhere and don't log out.
Nothing is approved in the wallet here: any funds are real. Rejecting a request is fine.
The wallet has no USDC on Arbitrum, so the deposit, the withdraw after it and a wallet rejection can't be tested until it holds at least 10 USDC (the dialog's minimum).
The page asks the wallet to add or switch to Arbitrum (0xa4b1) on load; the balance reads 0 USDC only after that switch.
There is no separate trading or withdraw page: Deposit, Join the Waitlist and every market card open the same dialog, and the address menu only has Logout.
The amount field opens with 150 already filled in, so clear it before typing.
The dialog's message reads “Insufficient balance. You need at least 10 USDC.” for any amount while the wallet has no USDC, so it doesn't tell a below-minimum amount apart from a balance shortfall.
